$description: Authored. The launch edit, as runs of song bars played in order. Every splice is on a bar line. 'end' plays to the end of the track. The first run starting at bar 1 keeps the silence before it.

pieces.why: the stop-start fill that sets up the drop

an eight-bar build on drop 1's own second phrase, run on from it and looped once: it cuts to a muffle on the bar line and opens steadily for eight bars as its bass drains away; a snare roll doubles every two bars, the song's kick doubles under it and falls away, noise and a pitched riser climb to the note the drop lands on (F); its loudness climbs steadily from 7 LU under the chorus to 3 LU under it, so the drop can slam; one beat of true silence

the final chorus, the slam: the whole band at full level on an impact the song doesn't have (a crash wash, the song's own snare and kick, a sub drop), 2.5 dB hotter than drop 1, straight out of silence
the final hit and its decay
